scripts.generate: pnpm -F @youj/figma build && node scripts/props.ts && node scripts/registry.ts && node scripts/samples.ts && node scripts/icon-svgs.ts && node scripts/gallery-core.ts && node scripts/loaders.ts && node scripts/palette-art.ts && node scripts/showcase.ts
scripts.build: pnpm generate && next build && node scripts/page-weight.ts && node scripts/js-budget.ts
scripts.cf:check:production: node scripts/cf-env-secrets.ts --check production && pnpm cf:build:production && CF_SEND_TELEMETRY=false cf deploy --prebuilt --dry-run
scripts.cf:ci:deploy: node scripts/cf-secrets.ts && { CF_SEND_TELEMETRY=false cf deploy --prebuilt --secrets-file .secrets.json; status=$?; rm -f .secrets.json; exit $status; }
scripts.cf:release:production: node scripts/cf-env-secrets.ts --check production && node scripts/build-static.ts --expect production && pnpm cf:build:production && CF_SEND_TELEMETRY=false cf deploy --prebuilt --secrets-file .secrets.production.json
scripts.cf:release:production:public: node scripts/build-static.ts --expect production && pnpm cf:build:production && CF_SEND_TELEMETRY=false cf deploy --prebuilt
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/loaders.ts && node scripts/palette-art.ts && node scripts/showcase.ts && fumadocs-mdx && tsc --noEmit
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:shapes && pnpm test
